integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically. The bundled finite replay is regression evidence only and is not presented as an exhaustive proof of the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the cyclotomic family \(n=\Phi_3(b)\) with \(b\not\equiv1\pmod3\); it does not determine arbitrary digit-sum Frobenius numbers or the excluded gcd-obstructed congruence class.
title: Exact Frobenius number for a cyclotomic digit-sum arc family
